nurse.text: Dia dhuit, and welcome to the Dún na nGall Sanctuary! Come in out of the weather and let me see your team.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop them on the bench there by the window. You can see the castle from here, if the rain lets you.
There now. All mended. Slán abhaile, safe home.
The Ark is the machine in the corner. It hums in Irish, if you listen.

else.text: No bother at all. Call in any time, even just for the heat.
